# Equipment Demarcation and Packaging Strategy: OFCI vs. CFCI {#sec-ofci-vs-cfci}

## The procurement matrix: Categorization of plant into CFCI, OFCI, and Owner-Furnished, Owner-Installed (OFOI)

To protect Ready-for-Service ([RFS]{.gls}) milestones against supply-chain lead times that routinely span 50 to 80+ weeks for medium-voltage switchgear, 2.5–4.0 MW standby diesel generators, water-cooled centrifugal chillers, and Coolant Distribution Units ([CDUs]{.gls key="cdu"}), hyperscale and colocation employers frequently execute frame agreements with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) prior to appointing the main [EPC]{.gls} contractor [@ref02_linesight; @ref09_orbital_glossary].

The MEP-QS must classify every major asset across three commercial procurement categories [@rics2021nrm2; @ref09_orbital_glossary]:

- **[OFCI]{.gls} (Owner-Furnished, Contractor-Installed)**: The Employer procures and pays for the capital equipment directly; the EPC Contractor takes custodial delivery at the site perimeter, offloads, rigs, installs, terminates, and integrates the equipment into Level 1–5 commissioning.
- **[CFCI]{.gls} (Contractor-Furnished, Contractor-Installed)**: The EPC Contractor procures, supplies, installs, and warrants all balance-of-plant ([BoP]{.gls}) distribution systems (piping, ductwork, busways, cables, containment, supports, fire protection, and controls).
- **[OFOI]{.gls} (Owner-Furnished, Owner-Installed)**: IT server racks, AI/HPC clusters, active core networking switches, and occasionally vendor-turnkey security or specialty battery enclosures installed directly by the Employer's IT integration teams.

## Commercial boundary definitions: Offloading, inside-building rigging, setting to pad, and anchor-bolt torque verifications

Ambiguity at the physical handover seam between an OEM delivery truck and the contractor's installation crew is a leading source of variation claims [@ref01_projectassure; @ref09_orbital_glossary]. The tender BOQ and Employer's Requirements must price and allocate:

1. **Incoterms 2020 Delivery Point**: Clarifying whether OFCI plant arrives *DAP/DDP Project Site (On-Truck)*—requiring the EPC contractor to provide heavy mobile cranes (200t–500t), spreader bars, and rigging insurance from the vehicle bed—or *Offloaded at Laydown Yard* [@rics2021nrm2].
2. **Inside-Building Rigging & Skidding**: Providing temporary structural floor protection plates, air-skates or hydraulic jack-and-slide systems, structural leave-out wall openings, and final seismic anchor-bolt installation and calibrated torque verification [@bicsi2024002].
3. **Shipping Split Re-Assembly**: Large MV switchboards, chillers, and AHUs ship in modular sections; the BOQ must specify whether inter-panel bus-bar torquing, refrigerant piping Brazing, and internal control harness reconnection are performed by the OEM's field technicians or the CFCI trade subcontractor [@ref10_lvi_epc_manager].

## Responsibility assignment matrices (RACI) for terminal points: Pipe flanges, electrical bus stabs, and dry-contact BMS inputs

To eliminate scope gaps between OEM vendor packages and MEP trade subcontracts, the MEP-QS maps the physical custody and terminal seam illustrated in @fig-ofci-cfci-demarcation and incorporates a binding **Terminal Point Demarcation Schedule (RACI Matrix)** (@tbl-ofci-cfci-raci) into every subcontract package [@rics2021nrm2; @ref09_orbital_glossary; @ref12_bidforge]:

::: {#fig-ofci-cfci-demarcation}

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  subgraph OEM["OFCI OEM Scope (Employer Purchase)"]
    A["Factory Build &\nLevel 1 FAT"]
    B["Site Perimeter Delivery\n(DAP / DDP Hook)"]
    C["Skid Bus-Stabs,\nFlanges & Gateway"]
    A --> B --> C
  end
  subgraph EPC["CFCI EPC Contractor Scope"]
    D["Cranage, Skidding &\nSeismic Anchors"]
    E["Valves, Lugs, Busway\n& Cat6A I/O Cabling"]
    F["Level 2 SAT to\nLevel 5 IST"]
    D --> E --> F
  end
  subgraph IT["OFOI Employer IT Scope"]
    G["Compute Racks &\nCore Networking"]
  end
  C ==>|"Custody & Terminal\nDemarcation Seam"| D
  F ==>|"White Tag RFS\nHandover"| G
```

Physical Custody and Terminal Point Demarcation Across OFCI, CFCI, and OFOI Scopes
:::

| Interface Seam | OFCI OEM Vendor Scope | CFCI MEP Trade Contractor Scope | QS Measurement & Pricing Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hydronic Flanges (Chillers, CDUs, CRAHs)** | Companion counter-flanges or grooved stubs at skid edge. | Isolation valves, flexible bellows, dielectric unions, bolts, gaskets, and pipe insulation up to equipment collar [@rics2021nrm2]. | Measure flexible connectors and valve sets per equipment connection pair (No.) [@rics2021nrm2]. |
| **Electrical Power Terminations (MV/LV/UPS/Gen)** | Factory bus-stabs, pre-drilled gland plates, and internal CTs. | Bi-metallic compression lugs, brass/SS cable glands, busway flex-link adapters, torque-seal marking, and phase rotation testing [@bicsi2024002]. | Measure terminations per conductor end by cross-sectional area ($\text{mm}^2$) plus adapter kits (No.) [@rics2021nrm2]. |
| **Controls, BMS & EPMS Interfaces** | Factory-mounted DDC/PLC controller with BACnet IP / Modbus TCP gateway card and dry-contact terminal strip. | Cat6A shielded communication cabling, hardwired fire-trip/interlock cabling, IP addressing, and point-to-point graphics mapping [@ref14_cxplanner]. | Measure per physical/soft I/O point verified through Level 4 FPT [@rics2021nrm2; @ref14_cxplanner]. |

## Owner delay mechanisms: Evaluating contractor stand-down, demurrage, and preservation costs for late OFCI deliveries

When OFCI equipment arrives late, out-of-sequence, or with factory defects, the Employer breaches its implied or express supply obligations under the EPC contract, entitling the Contractor to claim an **Extension of Time ([EOT]{.gls})** and **Prolongation / Disruption Costs** (@sec-variation-governance-claims; e.g., under modified FIDIC Silver Book Sub-Clause 8.4/8.5 and Clause 20) [@fidic2017silver; @ref01_projectassure]. Conversely, if OFCI equipment arrives *ahead* of building dry-in readiness, the MEP-QS must evaluate:

- **Climate-Controlled Warehousing & Demurrage**: Bonded storage fees, double-handling crane lifts, and transport re-mobilization.
- **Preservation Maintenance**: Continuous energizing of anti-condensation space heaters in MV switchgear and generators, dry-nitrogen positive-pressure blanketing of chiller and CDU heat exchangers, and periodic shaft rotation to prevent bearing brinelling during extended storage [@ref09_orbital_glossary; @ref14_cxplanner].

## Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) travel, witnessing allowances, and international factory logistics commercialization

Level 1 Factory Acceptance Testing ([FAT]{.gls}) occurs at OEM manufacturing plants across Europe, North America, Asia, or the Middle East [@ref14_cxplanner]. The MEP-QS must establish transparent **Provisional Sums** or itemized schedule allowances covering:

- Business/economy airfare, accommodation, per-diem subsistence, and visa costs for the Employer's representatives, the independent Commissioning Agent ([CxA]{.gls}), and the EPC Contractor's lead MEP engineers [@rics2021nrm2; @ref14_cxplanner].
- **Re-Inspection Back-Charges**: Contractual deductions stipulating that if an OEM fails a witnessed FAT run due to manufacturing non-conformance, all travel and man-hour costs for the repeat FAT witness trip are back-charged to the defaulting party [@fidic2017silver; @ref19_datacenterscope_cx].
